visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a slow-motion close-up of steaming Jajangmyeon in a white bowl. The dark, glossy sauce is filled with diced tofu and kelp, topped with fresh cucumber strips, sesame seeds, and a boiled egg half. (2) Hands enter the frame, pouring clear vegetable oil from a glass bowl into a black stone-textured frying pan. (3) The chef adds thick black bean paste into the hot oil, stirring it vigorously with a wooden spatula until it becomes fragrant and slightly bubbly. (4) The fried paste and oil are poured back into a glass bowl for later use. (5) A montage follows showing hands adding various diced ingredients into the pan: kelp cubes, tofu cubes, potato cubes, onion pieces, king oyster mushroom, and shredded cabbage. Each is stirred carefully. (6) Diced cucumber and a generous amount of white sugar are added to the vegetable mixture in the pan. (7) The previously prepared black bean paste is poured back into the pan, and the chef stirs thoroughly to ensure all vegetables are evenly coated in the thick black sauce. (8) Water is added to the pan to create a simmering base. (9) Hands add mushroom-based vegetarian oyster sauce, soy sauce, a cornstarch slurry for thickening, and a final drizzle of sesame oil, stirring until the sauce is thick and smooth. (10) The completed hot sauce is poured over a fresh bowl of white noodles, ending with a shot of the noodles being lifted with chopsticks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking in a warm, friendly tone over an upbeat acoustic guitar-led pop background track. Subtle foley of noodle movement is mixed under the speech. (2) A clear liquid splash SFX is heard as oil is poured, followed by a sharp sizzling transient as the bean paste hits the pan. The wooden spatula creates rhythmic percussive thuds against the pan wall. (3) A sequence of sharp metallic and glass 'clinks' occurs as various ingredient bowls are emptied into the pan. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and rhythmic, aligning with the musical beat. (4) The sizzling noise becomes more complex as more vegetables are added, creating a broad frequency bandwidth. The narrator continues to enunciate clearly with high clarity. (5) A distinct water pouring sound effect marks the addition of liquid, shifting the acoustic texture from frying to simmering. Soft percussive transients mark the addition of seasonings. (6) The final phase features a heavy liquid impact SFX as the sauce is poured. The music concludes with a bright final chord, and the narrator's voice drops slightly in pitch for a satisfying closing statement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a clear and visually appealing step-by-step guide for making a vegetarian version of Korean black bean noodles (Jajangmyeon). It uses high-quality studio production to emphasize the texture and color of the food, making the recipe look accessible and appetizing.
